items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Allen was a trombone player... Allen went with Gene Coy's Black Aces... I went to Oklahoma with Battle and got with Gene Coy's Black Aces too... I went down to see him... he wrote me out here

items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: The girl was with Bullmoose Jackson. She had a good record out.

ctx.x: What was her name? The girl was with Bullmoose Jackson. She had a good record out.
